# terrakube_policy_set_parameter (Resource)

Create and manage an OPA Policy Set Parameter in Terrakube. Parameters are key-value inputs passed directly to Rego policy evaluation at runtime under `data.terrakube.inputs.<key>`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Parameter key identifier, referenced in Rego as data.terrakube.inputs.<key>
- `policy_set_id` (String) Target Policy Set ID
- `value` (String) Parameter value (supports strings, numbers, booleans, and JSON structures)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Parameter description or documentation

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Parameter ID (UUID)
